name: 强密码检测器（检查强度）

map.输入密码即时检测强度，分析字符组合与安全等级: Check a password against length, character variety, common patterns and repetition to estimate its strength and fix weak points.
map.密码强度评分 = 长度分（不足 8 位 0 分、8 至 11 位 10 分、12: Password strength score = length points (0 for under 8 characters, 10 for 8-11, 20 for 12-15, 30 for 16 or more) + character-set points (15 for uppercase, 15 for lowercase, 15 for digits, 25 for symbols) − penalties (consecutive or repeated characters, matches in the weak-password dictionary); the total from 0 to 100 maps to five levels from very weak to very strong.
map.注册或改密前自检口令，避免「四类字符但含常见词」的伪强密码。: Self-check a password before signing up or changing it, avoiding "all four character types but with a common word" pseudo-strong passwords.
map.长度、字符集、是否词典词。: Length, character set and whether it is a dictionary word.
map.不是。页面按长度与字符多样性估算，不含泄露库比对；判为「强」仍建议避免常见词与个: No. The page estimates from length and character variety and does not check breach databases; even a "strong" verdict should avoid common words and personal information.
map.所有密码检测均在浏览器本地完成，不会上传到任何服务器: All password checks are done locally in your browser and never uploaded to any server
map.密码强度评分基于字符种类、长度和熵值综合计算: The strength score combines character types, length and entropy
map.建议密码长度不少于 12 位，包含大小写字母、数字和特殊符号: Aim for at least 12 characters, including upper and lower case letters, digits and special symbols
map.避免使用常见密码（如 123456、password、qwerty 等）: Avoid common passwords (such as 123456, password, qwerty and so on)
map.不同网站请使用不同密码，定期更换重要账户密码: Use a different password for each site and change important account passwords regularly
map.密码强度检测器基于字符种类、长度和信息熵综合评估密码安全等级，并提供预估破解时间: The Password Strength Checker assesses password security from the character types, length and information entropy, gives an estimated crack time and improvement advice, and supports one-click strong-password generation.
map.实时检测，输入即分析: Real-time checks that analyze as you type
map.常见弱密码字典识别: Recognition of a common weak-password dictionary
map.注册账户时检查密码强度: Checking password strength when registering an account
map.安全审计中的密码合规检查: Password compliance checks in security audits
map.密码强度采用统一熵模型：按实际使用的字符池（小写 26、大写 26、数字 10、: Password strength uses one unified entropy model: the per-character entropy comes from the character pool actually used (26 lowercase, 26 uppercase, 10 digits, 32 symbols), multiplied by the number of distinct characters (repeated characters add no information); a full match in the common weak-password dictionary caps entropy at 10 bits, while containing only a dictionary substring subtracts 15 bits. The level, progress-bar colour, advice and estimated crack time are all derived from the same entropy value (assuming 10^10 guesses per second), so the level can never contradict the crack time.
map.`Password1!` 含常见词「password」，命中字典扣分（整词 −1: `Password1!` contains the common word “password”; the dictionary penalty (−10 bits whole word, −15 bits substring) lowers its grade. `Tq7!mK9@pL2#` has a large character pool and no common words → strong (high entropy).
map.当前浏览器不支持安全随机数，无法生成密码，请更换浏览器。: This browser does not support secure random numbers, so a password cannot be generated. Please use another browser.
